name: implement-project-scopes
description: Implements BlackAgents project scopes — one-level sub-scopes with a project.json inheritance whitelist — across domain, loaders, API/UI, tests, and a gated release review that sends failures back for repair.
task: Implement project scopes in the BlackAgents source following the `project-scopes` skill: one-level sub-scopes under .black-agents/projects/<id>/ with a project.json whitelist (inherits tokens: mcp, skills, rules, commands, agents, workflows, knowledge), scope-first fail-closed resolution, merge-order MCP config, activeProject persistence, a project switcher UI with origin badges, and full test coverage. All file changes happen in the BlackAgents code source folder.

steps.instructions: Implement the domain layer from the `project-scopes` skill seam table: parameterize SOURCE_ROOT in lib/artifacts/source.ts, add scope to Artifact in lib/artifacts/types.ts, add the project.json zod schema + loader, and extend scanWorkspace in lib/artifacts/parser.ts with scope-first whitelist-gated merging. Enforce invariants: one level only, id equals folder name, fail closed on invalid manifests. Follow the `typescript-strict` rule.

Make the service loaders scope-aware per the `project-scopes` skill: merge-order MCP config in lib/mcp/config.ts (project wins on name), scope-gated workflow and knowledge loaders, activeProject persistence in lib/config.ts (cleared on workspace switch), scope-aware @mention resolution in the graph. Then add the API surface: project CRUD and scope-aware artifact endpoints using the envelope from the `api-response-format` rule. All writes resolve against the scope root through resolveInWorkspace.

Build the project UI: a project switcher beside the workspace switcher in the header, origin badges (project vs inherited) on artifact lists, and a project management view for creating projects and editing the inherits whitelist. Follow the `design-system` rule and the `design-system` skill.

Cover the feature per the `testing-required` rule and `testing-patterns` skill: manifest validation (unknown tokens, id/folder mismatch, nested projects rejected), resolution order (project beats parent), fail-closed behavior for every non-inherited token, MCP merge order, filesystem confinement (../../ escape must fail), and API integration tests for project CRUD. Follow the `project-scopes` skill invariants as the acceptance list.

Repair the defects reported by the test or review steps. Re-run the failed tests and verify each defect is closed. Keep fail-closed semantics and workspace confinement intact — never weaken an invariant to make a test pass.

Verify every acceptance criterion from the `project-scopes` skill against the diff and the running app: create a project, confirm inherited artifacts appear badged, confirm a non-inherited service is absent, confirm writes land inside the project folder, confirm nested projects and unknown tokens are rejected. Issue VERDICT: approve or VERDICT: reject with actionable defects.
